en: The postcard features a riverside scene with boats docked at a quay and a ferry ('gierpont') crossing the river in the background. There are a few people standing near the dock, and some barrels or wooden items on the quay. The riverbank opposite the quay features trees and houses. The overall coloring and style suggest an early 20th-century era. The caption at the bottom reads 'Nijmegen - Gierpont.'
